fact_text: NCCPL releases the FIPI and LIPI sheet after the market closes each evening, showing net flows by investor category.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'MASTERING FIPI LIPI Analysis in the Next 15 Minutes for PSX Success | Part 01 |' (YouTube, 2025-04-19)

fact_text: FIPI and LIPI figures are in US dollar millions, not index points or percentages, and each investor row shows buying, selling and net flow.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'MASTERING FIPI LIPI Analysis in the Next 15 Minutes for PSX Success | Part 01 |' (YouTube, 2025-04-19)

fact_text: In the FIPI and LIPI table, total buying equals total selling, so foreign net selling is matched by local net buying in the same session.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'MASTERING FIPI LIPI Analysis in the Next 15 Minutes for PSX Success | Part 01 |' (YouTube, 2025-04-19)

fact_text: The FIPI sheet's debt segment covers T-bills and bonds, not equities, so it sits outside the stock market sector breakdown.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'MASTERING FIPI LIPI Analysis in the Next 15 Minutes for PSX Success | Part 01 |' (YouTube, 2025-04-19)

fact_text: Foreign corporates were net sellers of USD 3.39 million on 7 Apr 2025, which the analyst converted to about PKR 73 crore.

fact_text: Overseas Pakistanis were net buyers of USD 1.34 million on 7 Apr 2025, which the analyst converted to about PKR 29 crore.

fact_text: On 7 Apr 2025 foreign corporates sold their bank holdings, including UBL and HBL, according to the analyst.

fact_text: Local banks and DFIs were net buyers of USD 12 million on 7 Apr 2025, according to the analyst.

fact_text: Local insurance companies bought about USD 5 million and sold about USD 2.37 million on 7 Apr 2025.

fact_text: The analyst reads banks as buyers in sell-offs because they do not face immediate payouts, while mutual funds sell to hold cash for investor redemptions.

fact_text: The analyst linked the 7 Apr 2025 global sell-off to a US tariff announcement by Trump, and said Pakistan was on the list of affected countries.
